test_array_scalar_like_equivalence: test arithmetic operations between masked extension arrays and scalar values for equivalence
test_array_NA: test arithmetic operations between masked extension arrays and pd.NA preserve masks
test_numpy_array_equivalence: test arithmetic operations between masked extension arrays and numpy arrays match pd.array results
test_series: test arithmetic operations between masked extension array Series and scalars, arrays, or Series
test_frame: test arithmetic operations between DataFrames with masked extension arrays and scalars
test_divmod_pdna: test divmod and floor-division with pd.NA on nullable integer and float Series
test_unary_op_does_not_propagate_mask: test unary operations on masked extension arrays do not propagate mask changes
test_error_len_mismatch: test arithmetic operations with mismatched-length operands raise ValueError or TypeError
test_error_invalid_object: test arithmetic operations with invalid 2-d objects return NotImplemented or raise
